blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fifty years after the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) signed the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia in Bali, House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III called on the region’s lawmakers to keep the pact’s promise of peaceful cooperation alive by staying in touch with their counterparts across borders. “As parliamentarians, we are the guardians. We keep it alive every time we pick up the phone to reach a counterpart across the border, every time we disagree in this hall and yet part as friends,” Speaker Dy said in his opening address at the 47th General […]...
